'''Tanla Platforms Ltd''', previously known as '''Tanla Solutions Ltd''', is an Indian multinational [[Platform as a service|communications platform as a service]] (CPaaS) company based in [[Hyderabad]]. The company provides [[value-added services]] in the [[cloud communications]] space. Tanla has more than 600 employees across its offices, including two overseas locations–[[Singapore]] and [[Dubai]]. The company is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] in India.<ref>{{Cite web |last=ANI PR |date=2021-06-24 |title=Tanla Platforms Limited set to go global, platform business to propel growth |url=https://theprint.in/ani-press-releases/tanla-platforms-limited-set-to-go-global-platform-business-to-propel-growth/683619/ |access-date=2022-05-02 |website=ThePrint |language=en-US}}</ref>

== History ==
Tanla was founded by Dasari Uday Kumar Reddy in May 1999 during the [[dot-com bubble]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chakraborty |first1=Chiranjivi |title=Back from near-zero, India's own internet economy stock eclipses Tesla's mind-numbing rally |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/back-from-near-zero-indias-own-internet-economy-stock-eclipses-teslas-mind-numbing-rally/articleshow/80279489.cms |access-date=27 April 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=15 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210115074610/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/back-from-near-zero-indias-own-internet-economy-stock-eclipses-teslas-mind-numbing-rally/articleshow/80279489.cms |archive-date=15 January 2021}}</ref>

In December 2006, Tanla was listed on BSE and NSE after its [[initial public offering]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Cairn IPO fails to impress |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/cairn-ipo-fails-to-impress/articleshow/822242.cms |access-date=27 April 2024 |work=The Times of India |date=16 December 2006}}</ref>

Tanla acquired [[Finland]]-based [[mobile payments]] company OpenBit Oy (now called Tanla Oy) in 2008. In June 2008, Tanla picked up 85% in the company, followed by an acquisition of 5% in June 2009 and the remaining 10% in April 2010.<ref>{{cite news |title=Tanla Solutions makes Finland company wholly owned subsidiary |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/tanla-solutions-makes-finland-company-wholly-owned-subsidiary-110042200118_1.html |access-date=27 April 2024 |work=Business Standard}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2008-06-05 |title=Tanla acquires 85 per cent stake in Openbit for $ 15.81 mn |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/tanla-acquires-85-per-cent-stake-in-openbit-for-15-81-mn/articleshow/3103822.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-03-21 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref>

Tanla Platforms, in August 2018, acquired 100% of Karix Mobile (formerly known as mGage India) and its wholly owned subsidiary Unicel from GSO Capital Partners, a [[Blackstone Inc.|Blackstone]] company, at an enterprise value of {{INR}}340 crore.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Somasekar |first1=M. |title=Tanla Solutions acquires Karix Mobile for Rs 340 cr |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/tanla-solutions-acquires-karix-mobile-for-rs-340-cr/article24736589.ece |access-date=27 April 2024 |work=BusinessLine |date=20 August 2018 |language=en}}</ref> The closure of this acquisition was announced in April 2019.<ref>[https://tanla.com/news/announcement.html Karix announcement]</ref>

In 2023, Tanla acquired 100% stake in ValueFirst Group from [[Twilio]] for $42 million ({{INR}}346 crore).<ref>{{cite news |title=Tanla to acquire ValueFirst Group in all-cash deal of up to Rs 395 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/tanla-to-acquire-valuefirst-group-in-all-cash-deal-of-up-to-rs-395-crore-123060900291_1.html |access-date=27 April 2024 |work=Business Standard}}</ref>

== Services ==
Tanla Platforms Limited initially started as a [[Bulk messaging|Bulk SMS]] provider in Hyderabad catering to [[Small and medium-sized enterprises|SME]]. As the team grew, the company evolved into a [[Cloud communications|Cloud communication]] provider with services and products with aggregators and [[Telephone company|Telcos]] across the globe.
